title.en: Spirit, Token, Space and the Yi substrate (間 · 一/太極)

summary.en: A social ontology (a spirit holds a token in a space) that its builders reduced to one addressable root, Yi, with roles read off separately owned facts and a register of refusals; plus a running design and a political thesis. The live account never names it. Its gate, fork, mediation and non-inference forms have checked neighbours, by other routes and on declared models. Kept divergences: a stable root and an immutable Kind against identity and law read off relations, enforcement by construction, sovereignty by ownership, a human at the root, goodness with no premise.

name.en: Every social fact as one sentence over three primitives

source.locator: Three primitives, one canonical sentence; Claims 10-13

sense.en: Society is made of exactly three kinds of thing: spirits that act, tokens that are claimable units of meaning, spaces that interpret them. Every social fact has one shape, and with these one can model essentially any scenario where actors cooperate, compete or exchange under rules. The folder later finds this incomplete and retires it.

entries.quote: a Spirit holds a Token in a Space

reading.en: The account has no universal form of a social fact and does not localize this one. Its one institution model is an entry rule, which it says is no definition. 'Holder' there is a cohort's relation to a rule, not possession of an item: a shared word, not a correspondence. The universality is asserted by the source and not by the account. [AI reading]

says.en: 'a minimal model of one kind, an entry rule on a shared stock, passed through members who also keep it, with no compliance and no records. It is not a definition of an institution.' Theorem (root; a family of models).
Not yet done: 'An organism and one kind of institution each have one minimal model [AI reading]'.

account_adds.en: Exact laws for that one rule: the band of quotas, closed regions under revision, when a rule passes out, and two separately started states tested apart.

source_adds.en: The triad, token types, spaces as micro-institutions, and the universality claim, which the account neither states nor needs.

name.en: Subject, object, holder, agent as roles read off relations

source.locator: The loop that would not stay disjoint; The Yi turn; Claims 60, 83, 154-158, 239

sense.en: The disjoint triad failed in building it: spirit contains space, space holds tokens, token holds spirit, and a spirit's environment can be another spirit. So subject, object, holder, child, issuer, capability, container and agent are not categories a thing belongs to but readings of context facts, and one row can be all at once. Having and being are one substance seen from two ends of a relation.

entries.quote: a reading lens, not root types

reading.en: Same form: a split stated as positions in a relation, not kinds of thing. The account's checked case is narrower (formations and conditions, two roles of one relatum in the World, a modelling commitment), its wider claim a thesis, argued. The source reads roles off separately owned facts; the account has one kind of symbol. No line of descent is claimed. [AI reading]

says.en: 'One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate'.
A commitment of the representation, which the axiom report does not check: 'formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum' (`World.ofRoles`).
'Subject and object, actor and patient, observer and world, inside and outside, fact and value are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out.'

account_adds.en: That each split states what it leaves out; that responsibility is not shown to differentiate; that the thesis forbids explanations, not observations.

source_adds.en: Roles of holder, issuer, presenter, capability and container, one thing bearing them at once with several truths, and 'even the type of a thing is a thing' (which the source's own Kinds, never Yis, later give up).

name.en: Visibility and conditions as relations, not stored attributes

source.locator: The loop that would not stay disjoint; The actor turn; Claims 80, 99

sense.en: A policy is a spirit you contain, not a bit you set; caveats and visibility collapse into one mechanism evaluated at resolution time, and Ren rules that they emerge from relations. The folder lists this among two structural discoveries that survive into the substrate. Visibility here means who may see: a rule of access.

entries.quote: Caveat 和 Visibility是从关系中涌现的

reading.en: What can be seen is relational here too, in another sense: beyond a coupling closure is what no selection through it can reach. That is reach, not permission. Where the account has permission, a probe newly admitted, the permissions are supplied, not emergent. So the shared part is only that a view is formed and needs a fresh reading; the source's emergence of policy from relations is not stated. 'Condition' is a shared word. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): 'Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them'. 'A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.'

Theorem (periphery, pre-spine; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation 'can be told apart by a newly admitted probe, and an old view with the destination cannot rebuild the updated view without a fresh reading'.

account_adds.en: That the law's force lies in the premise that a selector selects through just those couplings; T6's invisible half.

source_adds.en: Visibility as an authored policy, holder-only by default, with policy itself a contained thing that can be read and changed; and its emergence from relations.

name.en: One stable addressable root that keeps its identity through every role

source.locator: The Yi turn; Claims 146, 150-153, 221

sense.en: A Yi (一, 'the one') is a bare root: UID, domain, primary kind binding, timestamps, a sequence, a commit head. It is the one addressable bearer of traits, relations, capabilities, state and behaviour, and it becomes subject, object or actor by composed kinds without changing its identity. Birth is immutable. Stated of a runtime, and also taken as the ontology's one primitive.

entries.quote: without changing its root identity

reading.en: As engineering, a UID is the move the account's models also make: naming given, equality on the carrier. The account lists that as a commitment of the model. As ontology they part: identity across steps is a reading of continuation, 'not a fact beneath it', and that the commitment belongs only to the representation is itself 'not shown'. The grammar's 一 is the full relation, not a bearer: a shared sign. [AI reading]

says.en: A commitment of the representation: 'The naming of relata | which condition is which relatum is given, not derived', on which identity across steps depends.

Theorem (World), 'Labels carry nothing': a renaming preserves the five readings checked, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. Section's opening: 'identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.'
Calibration (World): 'names carry one decided identity more than relations do.' Identity read off relations is identity up to indiscernibility.

Thesis, argued: 'the nearest case is equality on the carrier, which the model uses and does not derive; the thesis reads it as belonging to the representation and not to what is represented, and that reading is not shown.'

account_adds.en: Where identity is forced (a census with more active after a step than before); that succession across a dormant step stays possible.

source_adds.en: An engineering reason for the root: stable denotation, recoverable history and immutable creation across rename and reparent, which a running system needs whatever the metaphysics.

name.en: Identity as what is held, not a substance

source.locator: Three primitives, one canonical sentence; Claims 15-16

sense.en: In the 2025 framework a spirit's identity in a space just is the set of tokens it holds; across spaces it is the sum of its credentials, memberships and roles. The protocol requires only distinctness and continuity over time, not how a spirit is authenticated.

entries.quote: identity is not a substance but an accumulated portfolio

reading.en: Form shared: no nature behind the relations. The terms differ: the account's configuration is how it relates to its continuations (bisimulation), not a list of present holdings, so two equal portfolios with different futures would not be alike there. This entry sits against the source's own 2026 UID root: the account is nearer the 2025 statement. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): 'Configurations related by a bisimulation are alike: they realize the same claims, match each other's steps by the same move into alike configurations, and pass the same tests'.

Thesis, argued: it forbids an explanation needing 'a self with a nature of its own'. These results show configurations, laws and parts as represented need nothing beyond relations; 'Neither shows that reality has none.'

account_adds.en: An exact sense of 'how it relates', its limits (equality needed for intervening on one of two alike configurations) and two live arguments that would defeat the thesis.

source_adds.en: Identity as accumulated and social: credentials and roles given by others, plural across spaces, a 'social CV'.

name.en: A token means nothing outside the space that interprets it

source.locator: Three primitives; What the whole thing is for; Claims 18-21, 26, 299

sense.en: A token's meaning is supplied by its space, the boundary of relevance that stops a credential carrying authority into a context that never granted it. Only declared types are recognized. Later: no global schema or trust root; interoperation through exact kind identities and explicit local admission.

entries.quote: A token by itself is just a symbol; the space provides the interpretation

reading.en: Mechanism shared in part: a form has its sense only under a map. But the account's code is a formation's own map from senses to forms, agreed only through hearings; meaning sits in formations and their history, not in a place. The refusal of a global schema has a checked neighbour: an imposed code makes all agree and each loses the distinctions it drew. [AI reading]

says.en: 'A code is a formation's map from senses to forms.' Theorem (any type): 'An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source of the imposed code losing none.'

Theorem (any type): imposing one code gives 'agreement from symmetry without a formation above the others, by privileging forms'. The record does not show a code is in fact imposed or that imposing is better.

account_adds.en: How agreement forms and fails: symmetric starts never agree without a break, and a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining. 'None says whether a code supports or damages 生生.'

source_adds.en: Context as a load-bearing primitive; declared token types; authority bounded by context; cross-space recognition by reference or bridge.

name.en: The grammar as executable status functions (Searle, Mead, Goffman, North)

source.locator: Three primitives; Claims 37-41

sense.en: The token is X, the status Y, the space C: the grammar is a syntax for status function declarations, collective intentionality turned into an editable file. Tokens are the shared symbols of symbolic interactionism, a role is literally a token one possesses (Goffman), a space's rules are the rules of the game (North), and tokens are older than markets. The source says the 2026 documents dropped all this.

entries.quote: X counts as Y in context C

reading.en: No theory of collective acceptance or status here. The nearest is the shared code, a form for a sense agreed by hearing, read with 约定俗成 as use breaking a symmetry: agreement on a form, no powers conferred. Recognition is supplied or merged into a count, in §12 and in the rule protocol. Class-relative sameness is not 'counts as'. Nothing here says the omission is a defect. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: An account of institutional facts by collective acceptance, with named lineages in social theory and ritual anthropology.

name.en: Enforcement upstream: unauthorized action made impossible by design

source.locator: Why possession rather than permission; Claims 30-31, 45, 67; open questions 6, 32

sense.en: Permission is a precondition, not a punishment: possession of the right token in the right space is the proof of the right to act, with no separate list to trust. Compliance becomes a property of the design rather than of leaders' goodwill or vigilance. The reviews and the folder's own reader later doubt this: holes under it, and the loss of mercy and exception.

entries.quote: unauthorized actions are naturally impossible because the preconditions (tokens) are not met

reading.en: The account keeps apart what this joins. Its entry rule's holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation 'so the laws say nothing of them'; a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule; consent and penalty are one core class until removal is in the net. Complete mediation is supplied on its one such machine, and no reading of the records can establish it. So 'impossible by construction' becomes conditional on what no audit shows. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them.' Reading [AI reading, new]: 'a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule'. Not modelled: 'conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision'.

Record: 'That the runtime is completely mediated, with no write path outside the interface, is not shown: it is supplied'; 'That the rights held, the programs committed or their ends are legitimate is not shown.'

Reading [AI reading, D69]: an institution kept by consent and one held by penalties are the thermostat witness read socially, 'in one core class of "in being or not" while the penalties stand, told apart once their removal is in the net'; not a new law.
§6: 'seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance'.

account_adds.en: Kept promises and enforced contracts read as laws giving first, 'the law changes, not the state alone' [AI reading, D48].

source_adds.en: The capability move itself: no ambient authority, proof chains, attenuation, trust-minimized governance as a design goal for actual communities.

name.en: Ostrom's design principles as token mechanics

source.locator: Claim 42; What was lost, item 4

sense.en: Commons governance maps onto token rules: boundaries are membership tokens, monitoring a transparent ledger, graduated sanctions revocation. The claim is conditional on the framework being deployed; the source notes the 2026 documents no longer say so.

entries.quote: clear boundaries = membership tokens, monitoring = a transparent ledger, graduated sanctions = revocation

reading.en: The account reads the boundary rule alone, on one model with no compliance and no records; monitoring and sanction are named as not modelled, and it cites Ostrom only as treating boundary rules as held by those they govern. So one of the three holds, in a different mechanism: the door's strength is the keepers' count, not a token presented at it. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: 'Ostrom 1990 treats boundary rules as held by those they govern; this reads the entry rule only'; limited searches found no door whose strength is the keepers' own count, 'an absence in those searches and no claim of priority'.

account_adds.en: A band of quotas in which the rule holds; a quota too small only where a keeper turns away more than itself.

source_adds.en: Monitoring and graduated sanctions as mechanisms, and the mapping's other principles.

name.en: Simple token rules generate institutions nobody designed

source.locator: Why possession rather than permission; Claims 28, 43; open question 35

sense.en: Composed rules build hierarchy, promotion ladders and checks without anyone writing them: 100 reputation points auto-issue a role. So a space is a sandbox for studying social emergence, and complexity theory licenses the bet. The folder's own reader notes that emergence is claimed and never demonstrated: the examples compose designed pieces.

entries.quote: simple space-level rules generate unplanned macro structures

reading.en: A promotion rule read from what it raises has the form the account proves can lock: under its hypotheses a rule read monotonically from the share stays locked while what it does not read is lost. And agreement or differentiated roles from a symmetric start need something that breaks the symmetry. So emergence is not licensed in general; which structures form depends on named conditions. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type), under its stated hypotheses: 'from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked'. That actual metrics are so formed is T7, conjectured; in one trained system its bridge failed.
Theorem (two roles; periphery): 'among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure, whose warrant is open.'

account_adds.en: A sufficient way out of a lock: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound. 'That language is an emergent property', read as a guarantee, fails for deterministic schemes keeping the symmetry.

source_adds.en: The positive programme: composing institutions, and a space as a place to study what forms.

name.en: Institutions revised like software; civilization prototyping

sense.en: Rules written as data can be changed like code, so institutional change becomes routine rather than convulsive; communities run safe experiments and a library of proven components accumulates. 'Defaults minimize config; gates make customization unbounded.' Societies become seeds that can be forked and edited. Stated as prediction and design direction.

entries.quote: updating a rule in an STS space is akin to updating software, with version control and collective agreement

reading.en: The account's reading agrees that openness lies in how rules keep changing, not in a rule chosen once, and gives where it fails: an edit reaches nothing until a reading step, a revision takes only where a holder stands, and operating does not imply being able to revise. Editable is not reaching. Any 'better' here is C's, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: §7, Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Keeping it widening needs the rule held to change without end, and its changing without end is not enough.'
Theorem (any type): 'a rule that never reads is unreached; a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step'.
On the model: no holder, 'a revision does not take'; 'The band does not settle what follows a revision'. 'who decides a revision' is not modelled.

In one declared protocol, with two participants 'technical decisions can go on while revision of the governance itself fails: continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized.'

account_adds.en: The pace law: given two values, L steps fix every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.

source_adds.en: Version control, shared libraries of governance components, and rule editing from a UI or by an agent. The folder's reader notes that edits at conversation speed are not covered by its consent door.

name.en: The token system governs its own rules by its own means

source.locator: Claim 36; open question 46

sense.en: Rule-making is itself tokenized: an Admin token authorises defining rules and issuing tokens, possibly under multi-signature, so governance of the rules uses the same mechanism as what it governs. Stated as design direction, a virtue of uniformity. The folder's reader later asks who governs the compiler and finds no amendment procedure.

entries.quote: an Admin token authorises `defineRule`/`issueToken`

reading.en: Where holding a role lets one rewrite what confers the role, the account's loop is at hand: a rule formed by those it selects, and selection of the capacity to shape it. These need hypotheses (what returns to shapers, readers drawn from the selected), so the design is not condemned; its uniformity gives no protection by itself. The account's own protocol stops the regress by supplying a fixed higher procedure, and says so. [AI reading]

says.en: 02's Reading [AI reading, D45]: above the critical mass one start condition gives a rising capacity share and every configuration locked; below it control is not selected yet the course is locked the other way.

Reading [AI reading, D45], after the record's theorem: 'recursive selection favours mechanisms which increase control over future selection' read as a law with its conditions. 'Whether actual institutions or trained systems meet these premises is not established, and nothing here ranks open rule-making above capture: that needs C.'

Supplied: 'a fixed amendment procedure and the adoption threshold'. Record: 'the origin of the highest authority' does not follow from the protocol. 'how procedures are themselves kept or dropped' is a distinct question.

account_adds.en: An exact lever at a step: where rule-making gives nothing back to the rule-makers alone and costs them, the capacity falls. Capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control.

source_adds.en: Multi-signature rule change and governed Kind revision as actual procedures.

name.en: No graph inferred from another: the non-inference algebra

source.locator: The refusals; Claims 262-265, 277; open questions 42, 44

sense.en: Seven separately owned graphs have their own change and loss laws, and only one grants authority. Containment conveys placement, never permission; creation conveys no grants; visibility is never authority. These are laws of a design, not theorems. The folder's reader calls this refusal the most transferable idea in the corpus.

entries.quote: A contains B ≠ A owns B

reading.en: Same logical form in another vocabulary: a fact stated over one set of relations settles nothing the set does not read. The account proves it of order against the dynamics, and states as method that participation confers no authority. The source's relata differ (permissions against placements) and its status differs: stipulated for safety, not derived. [AI reading]

says.en: 'A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right.' Responsibility: 'historical contribution alone does not prove it'. 'no condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable'.

'If such a statement entails C (`Comparison`) at a datum on a frame with an extension, it fails at that datum for every order (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).' 'This is immediate, since "better" is free'.
After the law that viability is having a working plan: 'Admissibility is not permission.'
'Soundness supplies neither the truth of the basis nor any authority.'

account_adds.en: Non-entailment shown, with what it does and does not establish: toggling a predicate in a weaker model shows non-entailment, not that the fuller structure allows the toggle.

source_adds.en: The seven graphs and their laws; attenuation-only delegation; certificate.parent as the only transitive edge; 'one thing, several truths' held together with non-inference.

name.en: An assisting intelligence's suggestion is not permission to act

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 115-116, 229-231, 267-270; What the whole thing is for

sense.en: Advice and authority stay separate surfaces. An agent can act without becoming its principal; actor and beneficiary do not collapse into one effective caller; an agent can never raw-emit a miniapp, because the model's output is the least trusted thing in the system; delegated budgets are conserved, not copied. A worked containment design.

entries.quote: conflating a helper spirit's suggestion with permission to act

reading.en: Unstated for an assistant, but the form stands on two declared machines: a proposal keeps the rule until a gated adoption, and a commit is admitted only under current rights. Who holds the right is supplied, its legitimacy not shown. The account's alignment asks what a selection can reach, not how an output is authorized. The mapper's 'not carried' missed the proposal step. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process; one declared finite protocol, an instance): of review, enrollment, proposal, adoption, integration and handoff 'only adoption is gated, so every ungated step keeps the rule'.

Record, law 3: 'A commit is admitted only at the current generation, with every write permitted by the current rights, change allowed and its write units drawn from the reserve within the deadline'. Complete mediation and legitimacy of the rights are not shown.

account_adds.en: Deference as worth, not authority: on its own model a formation ranks deferring to a reviser against a route of keeping its law, by each one's loss with its excess [AI reading, RR2].

source_adds.en: The claim itself for assisting agents; a confused-deputy boundary, presenter and beneficiary kept apart, depth-0 delegation by default, budgets conserved across siblings, and validate-clamp-inert for model-authored code.

name.en: Agents as ordinary operators, with a human at the root of authority

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 14, 137-138, 193

sense.en: Agents join through the same door as humans, bear the same member label and can moderate; they have no privileged class or backdoor. Yet hero-as-principal keeps a human at the root of every authority chain, and acting for a human is a separate explicit path. A design commitment, owner-approved.

entries.quote: agents are operators, not exceptions

reading.en: The account shares the first half: a person and an AI system are formations of one kind in the unfolding. It does not state the second. No party is at the root, and on its reading (premise named) aligning an assistant to a principal adds capacity against what neither reads. A human root is a procedure whose warrant the account leaves open. [AI reading]

says.en: 'a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding'; alignment is 'not a bargain among separate owners of value'. Reading [AI reading, D68]: 'Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection', the assistant's order rising with the principal's family being 'the reading's premise, not the law's'.
Among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated 'only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure, whose warrant is open.'

account_adds.en: That capable assistance to whoever shapes a rule does not lower selection for control [AI reading, D68].

source_adds.en: An actual assignment of answerability to humans, so that a chain of agents always ends at a person.

name.en: Operating infrastructure without owning a community's constitution

source.locator: The problem; What the whole thing is for; Claims 4, 6, 294-295

sense.en: The problem is political: a community on a platform cannot see its rules, change them without consent, or take them elsewhere. The theory's payoff: a host operates without owning the constitution, a package adds behaviour without ambient power, and members become participants in explicit contracts. Called by the source the point of the exercise, and offered as what the design could make possible.

entries.quote: without owning the world's constitution

reading.en: The worry stands here almost in these terms: running a shared interface and controlling its modification is a route of capture, read as a historical correspondence with no theorem. Whether this is degeneration is left open. The tests differ: the account asks who decides admission, comparison and correction next round, and what reads beyond the share; the source separates host from constitution. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: 'Running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence; a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round, not by removing one named practice'.
Open: 'Whether enshittification (relations formed in shared activity turned into control limiting later creation and correction) is an institutional form of degeneration.'
Reading [AI reading]: 'winners writing the next scorecard is `ReadsShare`'; what leaves is coupling joined to the selection.

account_adds.en: What decides a lock: counts of readers when the loss is read, and when.

source_adds.en: A design target: legible rules, operator competition, a host separated from a constitution, and explicit contracts. No live text takes these up; 05 §11 lists sibling programmes as applications, not this folder.

name.en: Leaving with one's history: portable worlds and forks that keep lineage

source.locator: What the whole thing is for; Claims 21, 89, 128, 295-296

sense.en: Migration should be an ordinary governance option, a sub-group that outgrows its home graduates by an ordinary transition in place of schism, and forks keep lineage without granting the source continuing control. Exit is what keeps operators honest. Stated as prediction and direction, unbuilt.

entries.quote: Forking preserves lineage without granting the source continuing control

reading.en: The mapper's 'not carried' came from a word search of the chapters; a record states forks. In one declared protocol a fork keeps its source as a branch and hands off the other, membership not exclusive. The account adds what the source's seed image leaves out: a copied rule with no one continuing cannot operate, and migration must be paid for. 'Exit' on the collective page is another sense. [AI reading]

says.en: Record, law 4, conditional within one declared finite protocol: 'A fork keeps its source as one branch and hands off the other, and a position can be present on both.' Chapter: 'A copied rule with no one continuing to take part cannot operate'.
Theorem (periphery): 'Selection must fund actual succession.' On a carrier with a part, a payload and a work budget; in a witness 'a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration'.

Assessment (selected histories, no theorem, not a universal law): in LibreOffice and Narwhal inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity under partial reorganization. Record: Narwhal 'limits universal third-party exit claims without establishing lost access control'.

account_adds.en: That operational adaptation, replacing a dependency and changed control over later adaptation each need separate evidence.

source_adds.en: Exit as a mechanism of correction distinct from reading, the threat of leaving disciplining a host; lineage with no continuing control; graduation in place of schism, which §12 lists as not modelled.

name.en: Where unification stops: a load-bearing split is a result

source.locator: The refusals; Claims 156, 175, 255-257

sense.en: The hypothesis that membership, holdings and the message DAG are one primitive was confirmed for the relation and the mental frame and refuted for the mechanisms, which differ along timing, residency, failure mode, context and cache lifetime. A rigorous 'keep this split' is worth as much as a unification. The folder's reader names this the one general method result.

entries.quote: Unify the DECLARATION; split the EXECUTION by its real axis

reading.en: The account has this discipline of its own: one symbol to write in, while each central declaration carries a counted distance from the root, a law written in the grammar is not thereby proved there, and amounts are conceded as not read off relations. The source's reason, that conservation has its own law, meets that last concession. Different domains, the same refusal to let a shared notation claim a shared mechanism. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Each of the 117 distinct central declarations has one standing against the edge of one root. Eleven are derived'; 'Six are counting'; 'The other 99 stand at a named distance, each with its reason'.
'A law proved on a model can usually be written in the grammar's vocabulary, but writing it there does not prove it there.'
Theorem (Flow and Web; the grammar's pairing): 'Amounts, the root's second sort: balance represented by selected unit matchings, not derived.'
Theorem (World): 'So the second relation is genuinely second only for a falling response with no complement'.

account_adds.en: 'a shared notation establishes no constitutive connection'; on a first count a rival dropping the word ties, and 'the word adds nothing'.

source_adds.en: A criterion by engineering axes (timing, residency, failure mode), and the seam: one author surface, specialized below it, 'a hidden divergence is not' a defect.

name.en: Against metaphysical compression: 'just a tie' loses handles

source.locator: The counterexamples; Claims 238, 315; open question 7

sense.en: The sharpest internal critique: declaring every connection one primitive feels elegant and loses what must be told apart. Membership against role against ban, holding against containment against delegation, feed against read permission are product facts, not notation; the old zoo is replaced by a more abstract one. Elegance has to be earned by closure, not renaming.

entries.quote: If every concept is declared 'just a tie,' the architecture may feel elegant while losing operational handles

reading.en: Aimed at an engineering vocabulary, it argues against the form the account uses: one kind of symbol. Kept as a test. The account concedes part: as a language it forbids nothing, content comes through hypotheses, and most central results use no root law. What the critique still asks: whether 'read as condition' can tell a ban from a role at all without what the models add. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences, and builds everything else from relations by a few operations'.
Thesis, argued: 'What it forbids. As a language, nothing: any carrier, relation and class will do'.
'Of the central results a few are cases of the root, more use its laws in their proofs and most use none'; 'Most laws below add what the root leaves free'.

account_adds.en: An account of what the shared symbol is not: that its laws forbid no relation, stated, with a rival's possible defeat named.

source_adds.en: The list of distinctions a practice cannot do without, and a working test: can the unified form still operate them? The account has no such test of its root against a practice.

name.en: Possession cannot express prohibition

source.locator: The counterexamples; Claims 306-309; open question 31

sense.en: Bans, mutes, blocks and timeouts are social facts not held by their subject. The review lists negative rights among what the design cannot do elegantly; moderation, appeal and sanctions must be designed, not derived. The folder's reader concludes that the founding sentence is incomplete: a space imposing a state on a spirit may be a second irreducible relation.

entries.quote: a token you hold cannot express a right you have been denied

reading.en: The grammar has a complement, so a negative relation is writable; that is not this claim. Entry is modelled as a count turned away, and 05 lists why anyone is turned away, conduct other than entry and sanctions as not modelled. 'An imposed code' is another mechanism, a shared word. Exchange of harms is a reading on loops. Whether imposing is irreducible is not asked. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A candidate second relation of imposition, and moderation as its own system of report, appeal and evidence.

searched: prohibit, ban, exclusion (the mapper's hit lists: forbids in the sense of a thesis, formal exclusion, none a ban; not rerun)
sanction and moderat across all records (one sanction hit, the rule's not-modelled list; one moderat hit, not on this)

name.en: Endings with form: release, composting, commemoration; no erased history

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 113-114, 117

sense.en: A community's life is a named sequence: doorway, welcome token, graduation, deactivation, release, composting, commemoration. Leaving is an act with a form; what stops is metabolised, not deleted; a community that can delete its record can rewrite who it was. A claim about how groups stay alive, in an archived kit stated as value stance.

entries.quote: what a community stops doing is metabolised and remembered rather than deleted

reading.en: Near match in the account's practical table: 'end' has its grounds, and deleted records change the judgment. It is conditional on living significance and J1–J4, scope from the continuation condition, any order needing C, neither asserted. The source says it plainly as a stance. Why erasure lasts has a neighbour only for codes, under hearings that copy. 'Generative endings' is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences). Response 'end', grounds: 'fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses'; what changes the judgment: 'renaming, deleted records, hidden undertakings'.

Under hearings that copy: 'a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. A resolution written back into the records that later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on.'

account_adds.en: Preserve, transform and transfer beside end, each with what changes the judgment; 'nominal succession' among what changes the judgment of a transfer.

source_adds.en: Composting and commemoration as named transitions, witness minted to those present, and graduation as a threshold of belonging.

name.en: A good existence: more possibilities, values coded into the world

source.locator: What the whole thing is for; Claims 3, 88, 90; In Ren's own words 13, 15, 17

sense.en: The bonfire gives warmth and gathers people; it is a good existence because it creates more possibilities, strengthens trust and makes us more aligned; it does not worship moloch or the market. Values can be coded as rules of the world. The substrate is a digital operating system for 仁义礼智信. Stated without a premise.

entries.quote: it creates more possibilities

reading.en: 'More possibilities, so good' has C's form, and the account will not assert it: widening what can form is better only under C for order, with the continuation condition for scope, both unasserted, warrant open. No law says trust or alignment is good, and nothing derives C. Coding a value is implementation, kept apart from warrant and compliance. 'Good' here names no comparer and nothing it reads. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Neither is asserted. The condition alone ranks nothing'; 'A ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place'.
'No law evaluates: none says a loss is a harm or restraint better.' 'C: widening what can form is better.' Widening 'needs no premise; that the wider is better does.'
Not shown: 'Any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.'

account_adds.en: What widening is, without a premise, and that mixed cases go undecided by C: more possibilities at some cost are not ranked.

source_adds.en: The five constants as the content of an operating system; warmth, gathering; a named adversary, moloch.

name.en: Infrastructure for consensus, joint action and culture

source.locator: The problem; Claim 3; In Ren's own words 17

sense.en: The purpose is not a product but intersubjective digital infrastructure: building consensus, acting together, holding and shaping culture. The README calls this the theory's real thesis statement, absent from the papers.

entries.quote: 建立共识，共同行动，保持和塑造文化，主体间性的数字基础设施

reading.en: Each of the three has a law on its own model: agreement as a code shared through hearings; joint action as compatible plans, which locally successful plans can fail; a practice kept as a rule passed through members. These are conditions and failures, not infrastructure, and they say nothing of whether any of it supports 生生. [AI reading]

says.en: 'where two forms differ, an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin'. Being joined through couplings is not enough.

Theorem (any process): where steps project and plans are compatible the zipped joint plan keeps both guards; 'Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step'.
'Promises do not': reciprocal eventual promises can be empty; ignition needs a reserve already present.
A minimal model of one kind, 'an entry rule on a shared stock, passed through members who also keep it'; 'It is not a definition of an institution.'

account_adds.en: Failure conditions; that symmetry must be broken for agreement; that mutual promises cannot start a loop with no source.

source_adds.en: A built substrate for it, and culture as something held on shared digital state.

name.en: Authority must be able to say why, truthfully

source.locator: Agency is a trait; Claims 195-196, 199, 249, 308

sense.en: 'Why can Alice do this?' must trace through held item, membership, delegation and gate as one graph of cause. Refusals that cannot be explained replace an arbitrary leader with an arbitrary machine. An explanation that fabricates a conjunction the runtime never computes would lie; and a mechanism built but unwired was marked closed.

entries.quote: authority you can `explain()` beats authority you *assert*

reading.en: The form appears for claims to knowledge, assessed and not proved: authority needs inspectable grounds. Premise-tracked derivation gives the form of 'why' but withholds authority by its own statement. The source's scope, legitimacy of a refusal towards a member, is not taken up, and no criterion of legitimate change is supplied. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment: 'Claimed empirical authority needs inspectable grounds for its distinctions; claimed continuing correction needs operative routes from relevant defeats to changed conclusions or methods.'

A claim derived from a basis under local premises holds wherever they hold; a local premise supports a conditional derivation, 'not its own discharge'; 'Soundness supplies neither the truth of the basis nor any authority.'

account_adds.en: Insulation's exact form: strong grounds against a claimed authority where a practice insulates a favoured verdict from evidence, that form alone not deciding standing.

source_adds.en: Explainability owed to those governed, as a condition of legitimacy, and a single answerable query with a truthful trace.

name.en: Standing is re-read at each decision; a cached allow is never authority

source.locator: Agency is a trait; The refusals; Claims 34, 194, 205, 265, 276, 287

sense.en: Move the equipped key out of its slot and standing disappears by semantic change, with nothing to sync. Every invocation re-evaluates current evidence; a projection is an accelerator in front of live truth, never a replacement; a capability is a handle, not a permanent grant. Stated as an absolute law of the design.

entries.quote: a cached `allow` is never Authority

reading.en: Checked neighbours on stated models: a certificate over an old envelope accepts what a recomputed one rejects; a record can stay true of its sample while reusing it now is wrong; the mediated machine admits a commit only at the current generation with current rights. Same structure: yesterday's evidence does not license today's step. The account states no general law of this. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core; computed cases are witnesses): 'the old envelope reused after the merger accepts the two merged supporters, a recomputed one rejects them'. Formulas and bounds are supplied.

Theorem (periphery; the two histories, moves and closure supplied): where a reference changes without entering what is retained, no deterministic policy from that view resolves them; 'A record can stay true of its sample while reusing it for the present question is wrong.'
Record, law 3: 'A commit is admitted only at the current generation, with every write permitted by the current rights, change allowed and its write units drawn from the reserve within the deadline'.

account_adds.en: Readiness as an exact condition on the induced envelope, and a roster failing wholly on a cause in no bound.

source_adds.en: The general law, its cost argument (a cached rate-limit or expired mute is an exploit), and the separation of handle from grant.

name.en: Split authority and peer-issued reputation

source.locator: Why possession rather than permission; Claims 29, 52

sense.en: One privilege becomes several tokens held by different people, and an m-of-n rule requires them to act together: checks and balances as token arithmetic. Reputation is peer-issued rather than platform-computed, and rules that gate entry on the web of endorsements are also the sybil-resistance mechanism.

entries.quote: with an m-of-n rule requiring them to act together

reading.en: The account says where such counting holds. Counting holders is sound only where they fail by independent causes: reviewers count by causes, not names; a copied witness changes nothing. m-of-n among holders under one cause, or endorsements copying one another, buy less than the arithmetic shows. The merely agreeing case is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Reviewers count by independent causes, not names.' 'three reviewers with distinct single causes are ready, and moving two of them under one cause makes readiness fail while all three names are kept'.
Inspection of the longer roster 'gives the same certificate at every pool of faults'; 'That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown'.

account_adds.en: An envelope over causal formulas and its readiness condition.

source_adds.en: Designs for peer endorsement and gating on it. That endorsement resists sybils is not shown in the account or in the folder.

name.en: One commit spine: an audit that cannot disagree with state

source.locator: One place where change happens; Claims 200-204, 250-251

sense.en: Every durable change lands atomically through one coordinator, the Occasion, binding changed roots to the commit; a write outside it fails closed; history, recovery and authority frontiers read one source. So audit cannot disagree with state. The folder also records a regression: an ungated read path leaked hidden rows and keys.

entries.quote: events are best-effort prunable audit, co-written same-tx so the audit cannot disagree

reading.en: Close structure, with a scope the source's sentence lacks. On the mediated machine, committed bounded programs keep coverage along every history, but only given no write path outside the interface, which is supplied; an outside writer leaves records and journal identical. 'Cannot disagree' then holds under complete mediation, and no audit shows that. 'Occasion' in 03 is another word sense. [AI reading]

says.en: 'finite histories of lawful reads and committed bounded overwrite programs, each taking its change scope from the fields it writes, keep actual coverage'; 'an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation'. Complete mediation is supplied, not shown.

account_adds.en: 'every acceptance reading only the public view that accepts the inspected machine accepts the changed one' (`record_only_acceptance_cannot_exclude_the_extra_writer`).

source_adds.en: Row as truth and event as prunable shadow; erasure and pruning from one source; failing closed as a runtime check.

name.en: Badly calibrated rewards get gamed

source.locator: Claim 44; What was lost, item 12

sense.en: The triad is structurally RPG state logic (character, inventory, zone), which licenses importing game design into institutions, including its warning that rewards too easy or too hard get gamed. The source notes that the warning has no successor in the 2026 anti-pattern list.

entries.quote: badly calibrated rewards get gamed

reading.en: The account places the fault elsewhere: a proxy on some attributes is a selection through the coupling to them, reaching exactly what couples in. Its force lies in a supplied premise. The issue is what a reward fails to read, not its calibration: a well-calibrated proxy still leaves the unread unreached. So the source's warning holds, and its remedy, calibrating, does not reach far enough. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise). 'It is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975; Amodei and others 2016; Manheim and Garrabrant 2018) as the account states it'; 'its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings'.

account_adds.en: The optimum's drain under room and the lock of a metric read from what it selects, each with standing.

source_adds.en: Calibration as a practical variable, and the claim that game design is a transferable body of institutional knowledge.

name.en: Mental resistance as the measure of a conceptual frame

source.locator: Why the pivot was necessary; Claims 177, 240, 248; open question 43

sense.en: A frame is judged by how many independent things one must hold in mind to predict behaviour at a point, explicitly not by primitive count: three primitives with a dozen special cases are worse than five that compose. A founder's 'hard to conceptualize' is a frame-smell. The first measurement missed its target, and the reader doubts that the proxy measures load.

entries.quote: the number of independent things you must hold in working memory to predict the system's behavior at a point

reading.en: The account has no cognitive measure of its own form. It compares rivals by what they forbid and by a count of patterns (08's thesis, 'a tie' on a first count), and writes reading times on its fronts; neither is this. The source's refusal of primitive count would apply to that first count. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A test of a framework by what its users must hold, with a budget enforced in CI.

searched: working memory, cognitive load, mental resistance, concept count (the mapper's search: no hits; not rerun)
read: ONE-PAGE's table row on what would show it wrong

name.en: No rhetorical victory before closure; every claim labelled

source.locator: The refusals; Claims 149, 243, 249, 252-253, 316

sense.en: If a document says the item acts, the first milestone must make that literally true in tests. Renaming is not the win. Every claim is labelled current fact, current violation, accepted destination, experiment hypothesis or rejected path. Code rises to the docs, and a violated law is kept, its cost named, not edited to match.

entries.quote: rhetorical victory before engineering closure

reading.en: Shared discipline: standings kept apart, a proof claim checked, relabelling shown to fail on one protocol. 'Do not edit the law' uses another sense of law: the source's is a norm a codebase must rise to, the account's a statement read off what it holds of, where a disproved property 'may show' a false law. The nearest match to that ruling is a frozen scoring rule. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Every result statement in the chapters opens with one bold label, and a proved result names its base.'

Conditional (practical commitments, with correspondence, authority and responsiveness, explicit in the protocol): 'relabelling without rewriting the encoding fails (`CommonTaskRevision.declaration_only_fails`)'.
'A requested change must be an executable sequence. A disposition to accept a stop or revision does not make the change reach the system and complete.'

account_adds.en: Machine-checked proof and axiom reports; 'a frozen rule fixes the scoring, not that it measures what the thesis names.'

source_adds.en: The five-way label for engineering claims, a CI concept budget, and adversarial reviews with measured fidelity.

name.en: Agency composed, not universal: addressable is not active

source.locator: Agency is a trait; Claims 187-192

sense.en: The main correction to a naive actor model: addressability is universal, agency a composed stack of owned facts (a signing principal, ports, gates, certificates). Holding authority is separated from initiating action. Universal agency is rejected on cognitive grounds. An item may itself act; this is not delegated to a helper.

entries.quote: Every Yi should be addressable. Not every Yi should be active.

reading.en: Shared: agency is not presupposed of what exists. The account reaches this by method (activity without presupposing an agent) and differentiation in the unfolding; the source by reducing what must be reasoned about. So the shared conclusion has different reasons. The account has no decomposition into traits. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Activity includes change and interaction without presupposing an agent, an intention or a purpose.' 'Relatively enduring organizations form within it, and some come to sense, remember, act and evaluate.'
'A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world'.

account_adds.en: The reading loop's laws, and that a part's choice is 'not a second kind of cause beside the unfolding' [AI reading, D23, D32].

source_adds.en: Orthogonal traits (messageable, agent, capability, container), four or five control axes kept apart, and an acceptance test for an item acting itself.

name.en: 間 and actor as one body with two faces, irreducible in philosophy

source.locator: The actor turn, and 間; Claims 95-101, 302

sense.en: A session is a set of actors and a place where things happen. 間 is actor, like wave and particle; neither is a special case of the other. There is a cosmic 間 and parallel universes at once. Caveats emerge from relations. It is first a philosophical system, irreducible in philosophy, reducible in engineering, one symbol enough.

entries.quote: 间即是actor，它们更多像波粒二象性，一体两面

reading.en: The source asserts an identity and an irreducibility. The account argues one unfolding as a thesis, with nonduality a method and no proof, and its cases are role pairs. 'A world is a run' gives plural runs of one law, near 'many worlds', not the same claim. 'No cosmic subject' does not answer 'cosmic 間', which is no subject. The root's symbol is 际, a relation, not 間, a place. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.' 'A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator'.
'that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.' Its neighbours include process philosophy and dependent arising.
Theorem (World): 'A world is a run of the process admitting every step'. Reading [AI reading, D43]: 'a run is one model of the grammar'.

account_adds.en: Two live arguments that would defeat the thesis, and its nearest case, equality on the carrier.

source_adds.en: Place as a pole of its own: the where of happening, beside the actor. The account's root reads conditions, and time as their reach; it has no term for a site. The theory of 間 is its own folder.

name.en: Change as one Yi touching another (Whitehead)

source.locator: Claim 304; What was lost, item 14; open question 41

sense.en: The glossary's verb for mutation, credited to Whitehead: every event is a touching of one Yi by another. The live vocabulary replaced it with manifest; the folder's reader calls the process thread orphaned, reality as occasions and not enduring substances, the biggest unexploited asset. Ren left the import undecided.

entries.quote: Every event is a 'touching' of one Yi by another.

reading.en: The thesis the reader says is unexploited is nearer the account than the verb is: one occurrence conditioning another, with identity across steps a reading of continuation. On the World an exchange has a footprint, but it is no relatum touching another, so 'touch' is partly a shared word. The source's bearer keeps a stipulated identity, which pulls the other way. The account's own Whitehead link is to enduring objects, not to touching. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences'; 'no frame or kind of thing is chosen before the relations'.
Record: 'Continuation relative to a class is close to genidentity (Lewin 1922) and to Whitehead's enduring objects (1929)', stated beside correspondences 'not proved here'.
Given idleness decided at every step and relatum, 'the least footprint touches exactly what is not idle and lies in every containing footprint'.

'the own courses fix the interleaving exactly where every exchange touches a relatum and every two exchanges are the same or share one (`LocalLaw.unique_iff`)'. Reading [AI reading, D30, D43]: the shared index of steps is 'a reading of the relations, not their ground'.

account_adds.en: Elsewhere the order is a choice among interleavings that moves where on the index a standing falls, not which standings a relatum passes through or in what order.

source_adds.en: Mutation as one bearer's contact with another; a route to develop process philosophy, which the account names as a neighbour of its thesis and, in one record, for enduring objects.

name.en: Anyone may define new kinds: what makes a world a world

source.locator: The social layer, last paragraph; Claims 180-183

sense.en: A user, agent or community must be able to define kinds, locally and unpublished, and others' agents must be able to discover them. A world is defined by the openness of its ontology, not its feature set. The folder's reader notes that no amendment procedure goes with it.

entries.quote: this is the key that makes worlds 'worlds'

reading.en: A checked form of why: hearing makes no form, so what can become shared is only what is in use; a new form takes coining. Openness of a course is what it admits, and the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes. A code's form is far less than a Kind. 'Openness is better' is C's, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted. No law says worlds need this. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Hearing makes no form'; 'the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use'. 'Coining is another mechanism.'
A form coined at one sense, 'heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again'. Stated where all hold a code merging two senses.

Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): 'what is possible under it from a configuration it reaches is possible from the first'. Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes'.

account_adds.en: That along a course of a stated process the whole possible never grows, so 'openness' needs saying relative to what is held.

source_adds.en: Ontology-making as a right of each participant; discoverability of meaning by others' agents; local kinds without publication.

name.en: Qualitative status and fungible quantity in one token vocabulary

source.locator: Claims 22-23, 55, 226; What was lost, item 6

sense.en: Tokens cover credentials, permissions, obligations and statuses and also divisible quantities, so economic and social capital blur and a community can blend them, say a currency that carries voting weight. By 2026 the source itself splits conserved assets (Custody) from issued authority, and the currency vanishes unrecorded.

entries.quote: divisible fungible quantities (currency, credits, resource shares)

reading.en: The account refuses this by method: conditions are not silently amounts, and amounts are a second sort its relations do not give. No reading of the selected relations returns the count, and that is conceded. The source's later split of conserved custody from issued authority moves nearer this, without saying why. Neither says what blending would do. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditions 'are not necessarily quantities that can be stored or exchanged, and no condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable; the World's natural-number amounts are a modelling choice'.

Thesis, argued: 'The World's amounts are not: no reading of its selected relations gives the count (`World.standing_not_read`), and balance is represented, not derived'; 'Until that sort is derived from relations, this is conceded there.'
Assessment (selected histories, no theorem): inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity 'as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts'.

account_adds.en: Markets modelled separately with their own laws; conserved stocks stay rivalrous, positional goods zero-sum.

source_adds.en: Fungibility and transferability as per-type design decisions, soulbound status so that meaning survives, and deliberate blending of economic and political weight.

name.en: What must stay private or evaporate: repair, absence, presence

source.locator: The social layer; The counterexamples; Claims 57, 71, 107-108, 312; open question 33

sense.en: Absence is information, not deviance. Repair runs privately, for visibility of conflict is a harm vector. A spirit's space is not a public profile. Presence is TTL-bounded, outside durable truth, and privacy depends on it. The folder's reader notes this quietly refutes the 2025 transparency assumption. A claim that some reading of a group damages it.

entries.quote: without turning conflict into a leaderboard

reading.en: The account's laws treat more coupling as more reach and do not model harm from being read. Its nearest points: position is zero-sum, so a ranked board has a race's form; a prediction can be read by what it predicts; neither concerns repair or privacy. Repair appears as RP, an actor-addressed reason. So the source's refusal of a reading is a real addition; no law says this visibility is a harm. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: That reading can damage what is read, socially; that some social facts should not last; the transparency-privacy conflict.

searched: leaderboard, surveillance, ritual, volatile, ephemeral, evaporat, privacy, presence, visib (the mapper's hit lists, not rerun)
read: 07-SIGNIFICANCE §5's RP row and the sentence on repairing a common support
03-KNOWING's opening of the entry on a prediction read by what it predicts
05-COLLECTIVES's opening of the entry on a race for position

name.en: The honest negative space: not every norm should become code

source.locator: What the whole thing is for; Claims 32, 300-301; open question 28

sense.en: The substrate gives no truth about external events, no legal recognition, no global consensus, no substitute for judgment. Untokenisable norms ('spirit must be polite') stay outside. The architecture is worth its cost only when several hard requirements overlap. The source concedes the boundary and does not theorize what carries such norms.

entries.quote: Not every social norm should become code.

reading.en: The form 'a formal system states what it does not reach' is the account's habit: correspondence is empirical, significance stays free, and 53 classical judgments are listed as inexpressible. The normative half, that some norms should not be formalized at all, is not stated. Each account's list is its own. [AI reading]

says.en: Not shown: 'That any actual collective, market, pool, entry rule or optimizer meets the hypotheses of a law'; 'the correspondence is empirical.'
A law with content 'can become a science's law for a domain only once the domain is shown to meet its hypotheses'; 'The account states no science's law of its own yet.'
「表达不了者五十三，各有其由」: including 社会之机制与特定之种（5）.

account_adds.en: A statement of why each is out of reach, sorted by kind of reason.

source_adds.en: That formalizing a norm can itself be wrong, and a cost test for adopting such an architecture.

name.en: One consent door, with the founder inside the rules

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 133, 136; open questions 36-37

sense.en: Everything entering a community (apps, bots, kits) passes one approval, moderator by default, and a record exists whatever the answer. Bundles may propose bots, never install them. The founder is inside the rules. Called the political core. The folder's reader notes it is per-install, not per-use, and may not cover gate edits.

entries.quote: the consent record always exists, *even for the founder's own agent*

reading.en: The gate's form is checked: where every other move keeps a quantity, a change must pass the gate, and in one protocol a change of rule uses a recorded proposal and a passing ballot. That is proposal apart from adoption. Its object is the rule, not what enters; a founder's standing is not modelled; and consent's warrant is not read. Consent elsewhere is a difference nonduality does not erase. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): a course that changes the quantity 'contains a gated move'. Record, conditional within one declared protocol: 'A step that changes the rule is an adoption with a recorded proposal and a ballot passing the rule of governance'. Supplied: procedural compliance and a fixed amendment procedure.
'Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence.'

account_adds.en: That a gate's law holds for any process, and that with two participants a technical decision can pass where revision of governance fails.

source_adds.en: A procedure of admission binding the founder; a record kept regardless of outcome; consent as the political core. By the source's own S6 a founder's control then flows from ownership, a tension the folder leaves standing.

name.en: Generators: conditional producers of spirits and holdings

source.locator: The actor turn; Claim 87; What was lost, item 2

sense.en: In the 2026-04 actor ontology a primitive produces spirits or holdings when coded conditions are met, defines what it creates, and can trade. No successor in Yi: kits install and ports fire, but nothing generates. Stated in passing as a direction.

entries.quote: they can generate spirits, or holdings

reading.en: A false friend. The account's generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, never arising and never any new organization. A site's token in 04's copying is a symbol at a site. No primitive here produces relata on a condition. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A programmable producer as a kind of entity, with trade among producers.

searched: generator (the mapper's hit, 01-ROOT's 'conditions and generators of further forming', another sense; not rerun)
read: GLOSSARY.md row on generation, keeping, degeneration

name.en: Meaning declared in the open, never read from a representation's accident

source.locator: Why the pivot was necessary; Claims 151, 178, 236, 244

sense.en: The pre-pivot failure: what a holding was got inferred from which optional field happened to be set at construction. So meaning must be declared and the runtime never guesses it from names, fields or layout; a name that says otherwise is a lie to be fixed in code. The source calls this the one law to keep if only one survives.

entries.quote: meaning should be in `kinds[]`, not in optional field presence

reading.en: The account's habit has this form for premises: what a conclusion depends on is stated where it depends on it, not left to a representation's accident, and a separate type asserts nothing by being separate. Its check is weaker than a compiler: that every premise is named is open. And it is about a theory's assumptions, not a running system's data. [AI reading]

says.en: 'the real assumptions lie in the modelling (discrete steps, one index, natural-number amounts, propositions as activity, identity by naming), each stated where a law depends on it.' 'Open: that every premise is named, which the completion checks support and cannot certify'.
'A separate type, a local resource account or a separate question asserts no fundamental separation, and a shared notation establishes no constitutive connection.'

account_adds.en: Labels carrying nothing on the World: a renaming preserves the five readings checked.

source_adds.en: The rule as enforceable law of a runtime: a compile step closing declarations into a plan, and a measured cost of breaking it. The account applies no such test to its own names beyond its checks.

name.en: A Kind as immutable semantic law, stored outside what bears it

source.locator: Claims 165-167, 171, 239; What was lost, item 15

sense.en: A Kind revision is immutable semantic law: genesis, schema, gates, ports, facets. Meaning lives in the Kinds a Yi bears, and a Kind is stored apart, never as a Yi. The founder's 'even the type of a thing is a thing' was traded for compiler closure. The source says so itself and treats Kinds as live governed law, revised by new revisions.

entries.quote: immutable semantic law

reading.en: In the account a law is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it, and the thesis forbids an explanation needing a law outside what it holds of. An authored Kind has the other shape: meaning fixed by a law stored apart. The divergence holds if the frame is taken as ontology. As a design it may not hold: the account's models supply laws too, and 'supplied' is local. The founder's sentence is nearer the account than the frame is. [AI reading]

says.en: 'A law of the theory is a statement that holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit. It is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'.
Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing 'a law standing outside what it holds of'; 'a law is read off the history it holds of (`shown_le_iff`)'.
'"Supplied" is local: a law supplied to a model need not be external to reality.'

account_adds.en: Theorem (any process): 'histories fix a law up to its dead ends, which occur only for unending sequences' (01, `same_histories_iff`).

source_adds.en: Law as a governed, versioned, installable artifact, with rollouts that select a revision and never mutate an old one.

name.en: Governance checked by the engine: quorum, thresholds, no action without criteria

source.locator: Applications; Claims 33, 49, 54

sense.en: Single-use vote tokens prevent double-voting, the engine guarantees quorum and super-majority, outcomes auto-issue the next tokens, and multi-party agreements run only when encoded criteria are met. Offered as design direction: the social generalisation of multisig. Formal voting did not reappear in the 2026 documents.

entries.quote: no action occurs unless the encoded criteria are met

reading.en: The account checks one such protocol: votes and thresholds decide adoption, and duplicate votes do not create mandates. It also bounds what that gives: procedural compliance, the forming of proposals and the highest authority are supplied or do not follow, and a decision is not a function of counts alone. So 'guaranteed by the engine' holds within a declared protocol and no farther. [AI reading]

says.en: Record, in one declared history: 'a proposal adopted by four votes changes the rule', 'adoption with two votes fails'; 'duplicate votes, a wait of thirteen days or an objection each fail'. Does not show: 'the origin of the highest authority, actual compliance with procedure'. No clock or consensus process is simulated.

account_adds.en: 'no function of the counts of roster, presence and reviews gives the decision in two histories of the protocol'; counts of admitted decisions are not consequences of the work.

source_adds.en: Issuance of outcomes as tokens, liquid and quadratic mechanisms, and the claim that such checks can run a community.

name.en: The token carries the relationship, not the payload

source.locator: The loop that would not stay disjoint; Claims 17, 64, 66, 238, 297

sense.en: Relationships are not hardcoded structures: a chat token says these spirits are in a chat, the graph carries relations and content stays elsewhere. Later a relationship occurrence can be a stable Yi with its own kind, state and history, not a join table subordinate to accounts, opening designs around mentorships, disputes and care. 'A tie' is the shared frame, kept as rationale.

entries.quote: the token is more about the relationship

reading.en: Agreement on what bears the social fact: relations, not account records. The account goes further and has only relations, between occurrences, with configurations as how they relate. The source's relation is typed and has endpoints as Yis, with its own state; the account's is a bare predicate read as condition, with no state of its own. Its World has formations and exchanges, not relationships as bearers. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences'. 'The carrier is a parameter of the statements, not a claim that its elements exist apart from their relations'.

Thesis, argued: 'a configuration is how it relates (`identifiesAlike_iff`)'; 'separation loses exactly the relation (`separation_faithful_iff`)'; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity 'is argued, not proved'.

account_adds.en: That one symbol suffices as a language, and what that does and does not forbid.

source_adds.en: A relationship as a first-class bearer with lifecycle and constraints, and the design space it opens; token-as-edge as a storage discipline.

name.en: Sovereignty through what a community owns: its address, its items, its rules

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 21, 123-124, 246

sense.en: A community must own its own path and items, not hold a slot under its founder, so 'who owns the wishing pool' is never ambiguous; each space keeps its sovereignty while optionally interoperating; a founder's guaranteed control flows from ownership, apart from who is in. A value stance and a design decision.

entries.quote: sovereignty starts with not living inside someone else's namespace

reading.en: The source grounds a community's standing in ownership. The account does not start from owners: no condition is silently owned, ownership is kept for actual economic relations, alignment is no bargain among owners of value, and a shared process has no administrator. It neither denies that ownership exists nor says the source's arrangement is worse. Who-is-in apart from who-controls has no statement here. [AI reading]

says.en: 'it keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations'; 'no condition is silently taken as owned'; 'no administrator entitled to speak for everything'.
Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, 'not a bargain among separate owners of value'.

account_adds.en: That an account of joint activity can start from actual relations, not opposed interests or a fixed common utility.

source_adds.en: Ownership and address as the working means of a community's independence, and tenancy as an unambiguous answer to who decides.
